dataset.name: Primary-source screening for one bounded open high-rate impact benchmark
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9J, close the S355 pair at descriptive-comparator status, and screen primary government, institutional or official solver sources for at most one bounded open high-rate impact benchmark. Selection requires a downloadable solver deck or otherwise reconstructible model definition, measured validation outputs, explicit failure or regularization treatment, exact provenance and a declared convergence observable. V9K performs no solver run, material fit or WTC/CF6 substitution.

candidate_scope.reason: Government primary report with generic metal-panel projectile experiments and finite-element comparison.
Government primary report on transient finite-element modelling of fan-containment impact events.
Government full-fan blade-out model/test report already classified as a tier-C method comparator.
Official open-solver example may provide a directly executable deck; it still must satisfy the experimental and convergence gates.

authoritative_primary_provenance.criterion: Government, institutional repository, official solver project or original experimental publication with persistent identifier.

lawful_open_access_and_license.criterion: Public access is verified and reuse/license terms for acquired model files are explicit; public-read-only access to a report alone is insufficient for a deck.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.criterion: A solver input deck is downloadable, or geometry, mesh, materials, boundary/initial conditions and contacts are complete enough for deterministic reconstruction without generic substitutions.

failure_and_regularization_complete.criterion: Failure/erosion law, all parameters, units and any characteristic length, nonlocal treatment or objective damage-energy rule are explicit; a bare deletion strain is insufficient.

measured_validation_outputs.criterion: At least one measured time history or final quantitative observable relevant to impact transfer is available with units and test conditions, such as force, impulse, residual velocity, deformation or perforation.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.criterion: At least three documented mesh levels or an explicit convergence/uncertainty study exists for force, impulse, residual velocity, deformation or another predeclared impact observable.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.criterion: The case is compatible with an available local solver or has a documented conversion route, and a later qualification run is estimated below 60 minutes per mesh on CPU without a multi-hour GPU job.

selection_rule.no_candidate_passes: Record a validated negative screening result and select no benchmark; do not weaken any gate.

acquisition_limits.allowed_in_V9K: Primary reports, repository metadata, licenses and small source-index files needed for screening and identity only.

predeclared_later_execution_convergence.note: These thresholds govern a later executed benchmark only; V9K does not calculate them.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: A repository record, license, source file, report statement, table or figure from a primary authoritative source.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A reported government or official-solver benchmark result; not reproduced by V9K.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No WTC archive claim is introduced and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The seven all-or-nothing selection gates and later 10 percent convergence threshold.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Per-candidate gate statuses, rejection reasons and zero-or-one selection decision.
evidence_policy.unknown: Any model field, measurement, license or convergence evidence absent from the inspected primary sources.
